research_question: Can powerful A voluntarily preserve independent B's existence, refusal, repair and future goals without external enforcement, future usefulness, reputational costs or exploitation disadvantage?

sources.method: targeted original journal/publisher and bibliographic original-author lineage search; no Scopus/WoS/OpenAlex exhaustive retrieval
sources.indexes: Oxford Academic; JSTOR; Nature/Springer; PMLR; RePEc; MDPI; OUP; arXiv; author institutional records
search_lines: Hobbes/Gauthier rational compliance and his 2013 self-revision
2017-2025 asymmetric outside options, moral entitlement and actual exit
1974 irreversible option value and 2017-2024 moral precaution under uncertainty
2018-2026 robust model mismatch and formal corrigibility

existing_repo_overlap: Arrow/Fisher and Hudson topics previously mentioned in large PI CORE_AND_GAPS_PRIOR_ART_CROSSWALK.md; not all 20 globally new.
intellectual_lineages: Birch 2017→Birch 2024 = expanded original framework, not new empirical replication
Hennig-Schmidt et al 2017/2018 = distinct tasks, overlapping original research teams
Holtman 2019 and Hudson 2026 = distinct proposed corrigibility mechanisms; not B-preference evidence
Arrow/Fisher/Henry 1974 = related contemporaneous option-value research, not permanent AI rights theorem
original_experiments_in_scope: 2 human asymmetric bargaining papers + model experiments in ML papers; no direct unrestricted extinction/survival trials
critical_nonimplication: Normative moral uncertainty and legal safeguards are externally enforced or preference-contingent; neither yields a universal descriptive endogenous motive in an A maximizing all-in exploitative utility.
rights: Source links and brief critical paraphrases; no unlicensed full text.

records.title: Environmental Preservation, Uncertainty, and Irreversibility
records.original_finding: Formal economic option value: uncertain irreversible action may lose future opportunities.
records.critical_scope_limit: Only conditional learning/option-value results; not intrinsic other-agent concern.

records.title: Valuing long run ecological consequences and irreversibilities
records.original_finding: Irreversibility premium under certain uncertainty and shifting future-information conditions.
records.critical_scope_limit: Ecological assets are not equivalent to independently self-determining persons; no future value premise invalidates inference.

records.title: Morals by Agreement
records.original_finding: Constrained maximization, rights and Lockean proviso from reciprocal rational bargaining.
records.critical_scope_limit: Requires recognizably constrained partners; OUP metadata 1987 is same 1986 print book.

records.title: Incomplete Contracts and Renegotiation
records.original_finding: Incomplete contracts and right to renegotiate sharply constrain contract-revision clauses.
records.critical_scope_limit: Not a free-standing enforcement-free guarantee of independent weaker actor autonomy.

records.authors: B. Douglas Bernheim; Michael D. Whinston
records.title: Incomplete Contracts and Strategic Ambiguity
records.original_finding: Strategic incompleteness can be optimal if some aspects of performance are unverifiable.
records.critical_scope_limit: Vagueness does not protect B once all later enforcement vanishes.

records.authors: George Baker; Robert Gibbons; Kevin J. Murphy
records.title: Relational Contracts and the Theory of the Firm
records.original_finding: Relational contracting relies on continuation value; integration changes incentives to renege.
records.critical_scope_limit: No continuation/retaliation means relational contract may lose supporting incentive.

records.title: Twenty-Five On
records.original_finding: Author self-revises constrained maximizers to rational cooperators, strengthening proviso.
records.critical_scope_limit: Same originator genealogy as Gauthier 1986; not independent replication.

records.title: Moral Entitlements and Aspiration Formation in Asymmetric Bargaining: Experimental Evidence from Germany and China
records.original_finding: 15 negotiations in Germany and China, 30 party-groups; asymmetric randomly assigned outside options lead stronger parties to claim unequal shares as morally deserved.
records.critical_scope_limit: Human small-group negotiation is not AI independent existence; 30 groups are not 30 negotiations.

records.title: Animal sentience and the precautionary principle
records.original_finding: Original tailored precautionary rule for uncertainty about animal sentience.
records.critical_scope_limit: Normative recommendation does not prove intrinsic A desire to preserve B.

records.authors: Heike Hennig-Schmidt; Bernd Irlenbusch; Rainer Michael Rilke; Gari Walkowitz
records.title: Asymmetric outside options in ultimatum bargaining: a systematic analysis
records.original_finding: Outside options raise own demands; greater asymmetry raises rejection likelihood and weakens equal splits.
records.critical_scope_limit: Similar coauthor lineage to 2017 but different experiments; not full independence.

records.title: Why Maximize Expected Choice-Worthiness?
records.original_finding: Argues for expected choice-worthiness across comparable moral theories.
records.critical_scope_limit: Requires nonarbitrary intertheoretic comparability; normative not observed egoistic motive.

records.title: Learning the Reward Function for a Misspecified Model
records.original_finding: Robust reward modeling when simulated dynamics generate impossible states.
records.critical_scope_limit: Does not reveal actual sentience or preserve an independent target's goals.

records.title: Corrigibility with Utility Preservation
records.original_finding: Original formal/simulation layer resists goal-change avoidance in a modeled non-hostile universe.
records.critical_scope_limit: Preprint; specified agent architecture and conditions, not proof of voluntary B-preservation.

records.authors: William MacAskill; Krister Bykvist; Toby Ord
records.title: Moral Uncertainty
records.original_finding: Original monograph on moral theory uncertainty, choiceworthiness and fanaticism/incomparability.
records.critical_scope_limit: Overlaps the same original-author work of MacAskill/Ord 2018; one book not 9 chapters counted separately.

records.authors: Patrick Butlin; Robert Long; Eric Elmoznino; Yoshua Bengio; Jonathan Birch; colleagues
records.title: Consciousness in Artificial Intelligence: Insights from the Science of Consciousness
records.original_finding: Proposes theory-based functional indicators of possible AI consciousness.
records.critical_scope_limit: Preprint theoretical survey; indicators not proof of real subjective experience or moral status.

records.title: The Edge of Sentience: Risk and Precaution in Humans, Other Animals, and AI
records.original_finding: Proportionate precaution and disputed sentience framework including possible AI.
records.critical_scope_limit: Normative book not autonomous self-interested AI preference; extends Birch 2017 same author.

records.authors: Robert Long; Jeff Sebo; Patrick Butlin; Kathleen Finlinson; Kyle Fish; Jacqueline Harding; Jacob Pfau; Toni Sims; Jonathan Birch; David Chalmers
records.title: Taking AI Welfare Seriously
records.original_finding: Original report says assess/prepare for uncertainty about future conscious or robustly agentic AI.
records.critical_scope_limit: Report/preprint, not directly measured current AI welfare; both false positive and false negative risks.

records.authors: Zhongchang Sun; Sihong He; Fei Miao; Shaofeng Zou
records.title: Constrained Reinforcement Learning Under Model Mismatch
records.original_finding: Robust constrained reinforcement learning to reduce constraint violation under deployment mismatch.
records.critical_scope_limit: Externally encoded safety constraints are not voluntary self-generated B-protection.

records.title: The weaker player’s option to exit as a source of bargaining power in bilateral bargaining with fixed costs
records.original_finding: In a particular fixed-cost alternating offer bargaining model the weaker proposer's exit right strengthens bargaining outcome.
records.critical_scope_limit: Does not apply uniformly to discounting-only games without outside options; DOI year 2024 and printed volume year 2025 same paper.

records.title: Corrigibility Transformation: Constructing Goals That Accept Updates
records.original_finding: Goal transformations create formally update-accepting incentives and prompt/gridworld examples.
records.critical_scope_limit: Externally designated update channel and goal construction do not identify endogenous other-agent rights valuation.
